We intend to continue to invest in the development and enhancement of our products to expand their capabilities and allow our users to realize the full benefit of our offerings.
We expect engineers, designers, and product managers to represent a significant portion of our employees for the foreseeable future.
As a result, the impact resulting from our research and development investments may be difficult to forecast.

We believe that our existing cash and cash equivalents, short-term investments and cash flow from operations will be sufficient to support working capital and capital expenditure requirements, and any future share repurchases, for at least the next 12 months.
The timing and amount of any repurchases will be determined at the Company’s discretion, and the program does not obligate the Company to acquire any particular amount of shares.

As of September 30, 2026, our deferred revenues balance was $513.6 million and is expected to be recognized as revenue within the next 12 months, provided all other revenue recognition criteria have been met.

To the extent that there are differences between our estimates and actual results, our future financial statement presentation, financial condition, results of operations, and cash flows will be affected.

statements.t: At the beginning of the year, we laid out a plan to prioritize teaching better and user growth, knowing it would take time to see results.
We expect this momentum to continue, with year-over-year DAU growth in Q4 similar to Q3, and Q4 bookings slightly ahead of the guidance implied by our previous full-year outlook.
Last quarter we began giving unlimited access to Video Call to new Super subscribers, and we’re on track to make it available to all Super subscribers by the end of this year.
Since unlimited Video Call will be part of Super, we've decided to sunset Duolingo Max, our highest subscription tier.

This month, we will stop selling new Max subscriptions and move existing Max individual subscribers to a Super family plan at the same price, giving them the same feature set plus the added benefit of sharing their subscription with family or friends.
The bookings effect of this should be minimal and is reflected in our Q4 guidance.
We are still considering options for legacy subscribers on the Max family plan, but we will address this in 2027.
We plan to continue building on this format with a regular cadence of collection events.
We entered 2026 with a plan to invest in our product and reaccelerate user growth while delivering healthy financial results.
We also delivered bookings, revenue, and Adjusted EBITDA ahead of our most recent guidance.
As bookings growth reaccelerates, we expect revenue growth to follow.
This bonus was previously excluded from our outlook.
We are providing the following guidance for the fourth quarter and full year ending December 31, 2026.
(1) Our guidance in the table above assumes foreign exchange rates as of October 30, 2026.
We are raising our full-year guidance across all key financial metrics.
We expect to finish 2026 at the high end of both the 10% to 12% bookings growth and 15% to 18% revenue growth targets we set at the start of the year.

We expect full-year Adjusted EBITDA of $323 million, or a 26.5% margin, up $3 million from our previous guidance, and $21 million above the midpoint of our original 2026 guidance provided in February.
We expect stock-based compensation of approximately 14% of revenue for 2026.
Before share repurchases, we anticipate dilution from equity grants of 3.5% to 4.0%.
We expect Q4 bookings of $382 million, up 13% over the prior year.
We expect Q4 revenue of $322 million, up 14% over the prior year.
As a reminder, given our international exposure, we estimate that every 1% move in the U.S. dollar against our currency basket will impact Q4 bookings by approximately $2 million.
We expect gross margin of 72.0% in Q4, down 90 basis points sequentially as we expand the rollout of AI-based features on our platform.
We expect Q4 Adjusted EBITDA of $84 million, or a 26.1% margin.

This outlook includes an additional accrual for the remainder of our company-wide DAU performance bonus, which was not previously included in our guidance, as well as the timing shift of certain expenses from Q3 into Q4.
We look forward to sharing our 2027 outlook when we report fourth quarter results in February.

The estimated dilutive effect is calculated as the number of shares expected to be issued upon vesting or exercise, adjusted for the strike price proceeds that are received by the Company and assumed to be used to repurchase shares of Duolingo common stock.
